description: Restricted six-accession live queue canary (ADR-095). This is a cohort in its own right, NOT shard 0 and shard 1 of domestic-primary-documents: its shard indices 0 and 1 are relative only to these six enumerated accessions, and the full queue's shard 0 contains entirely different accessions. Twelve requests, fourteen bundle rows. Coverage is deliberate: two shared accessions (3 and 7 carrier rows), two 10-KT filings, both measured href forms (viewer and direct), and the Spire accession carrying filename-plus-source-hash ground truth as a byte-level reproducibility control. Five accessions were measured by earlier completed runs; 0001888524-22-003213 has never been fetched, so no ground truth is asserted for it. Possessing this definition authorizes no request.
